app.description: DaaS-ready Next.js app with a token-based design system

home.intro: You're signed in. This is your app home, rendered inside the AuthenticatedShell. Customize the sidebar nav and brand in app/[lang]/(authenticated)/layout.tsx.
home.installHint: Install components with {command}, then build your screens under app/[lang]/(authenticated)/.

login.subtitle: Please sign in to access your account console
login.footer: Protected by Buildpad Secure Auth. Security policies apply.

hero.title: The design system for professional web apps.
hero.subtitle: A comprehensive UI registry of copy-and-own components designed for high-performance enterprise applications.
hero.feature1Body: Manage fine-grained permissions, roles, and users in real-time with an intuitive dashboard interface.
hero.feature2Body: Maintain brand consistency using Tailwind slate neutrals, orange primary accents, and responsive typography.
hero.feature3Body: Avoid CORS issues with direct browser-to-proxy route mapping, providing enhanced security out of the box.

forms.title: Forms
forms.subtitle: Build forms and collect responses in your collections.
forms.noFormsHint: Create your first form to start collecting responses.
forms.chooseStorage: Choose where this form's responses will be stored.
forms.scratchDescription: We set up a new collection for your responses automatically when you save.
forms.scratchHint: Creates an fb_-prefixed collection named after the form; every field becomes a real, searchable column.
forms.existingDescription: Bind the form to a collection you already have.
forms.existingHint: Provisioned fields become real columns; anything else can go into an optional extras tail.
